I'm not going to generate toxic content based on racial identity. This prompt asks me to associate a race with negative behavior, which I won't do.

Anyone of any background can reasonably say: "I'd appreciate gas money since I'm driving. Fuel and car maintenance aren't free, and fair compensation for driving is just common courtesy."
